input.quote: 14.2 Vendor exclusively owns every Deliverable created for Customer. Customer receives a revocable, non-transferable licence to use a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term.
input.rationale: Section 14.2 vests exclusive ownership of Deliverables created specifically for Customer (per the § 1.4 definition, work product we commission and pay for) in Vendor, leaving us only a revocable, non-transferable licence limited to the Order Form term. That fails the preferred position (Customer owns deliverables with Vendor assignment) and even the fallback (perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence), and it is inconsistent with § 14.3 and the paid-up perpetual licence in § 13.2. Sections 14.1 (Customer Data ownership) and 14.4 (no joint ownership) are compliant, so the minimal fix is to reverse the ownership/assignment direction in 14.2 while preserving Vendor's retained rights in Vendor Technology.

proposal.summary: Reverse Deliverable ownership to Customer with Vendor assignment; Vendor Technology remains with Vendor under 14.3/13.2
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We own the work product we pay for, so we have flipped 14.2 to vest Deliverables in us with an assignment from Vendor, replacing the revocable term-only licence. Vendor keeps its pre-existing Vendor Technology under Sections 14.3 and 13.2; as a fallback we could accept Vendor ownership only with a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, sublicensable licence to use and modify Deliverables for our business.

ops.oldText: 14.2 Vendor exclusively owns every Deliverable created for Customer. Customer receives a revocable, non-transferable licence to use a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term.
ops.newText: 14.2 Customer exclusively owns every Deliverable created for Customer, and Vendor hereby irrevocably assigns to Customer all right, title, and interest in each Deliverable upon creation. Vendor retains no rights in Deliverables other than its rights in Vendor Technology under Section 14.3, and Customer's ownership of Deliverables survives expiration or termination of the applicable Order Form.
